nurse.text: Welcome to the Holyhead Sanctuary. Croeso! Last stop in Wales before the sea. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right you are. Sit down, and don't look at the swell, it puts people off their tea.
All set. Safe crossing. Do take a bucket. For emergencies. Not yours, the gull's.
The Ark terminal. It was shipped here by ferry and has never quite forgotten.

else.text: No bother. Come in out of the wind, it's a Holyhead one.
